# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnassqs)

# Create spatial references
pixel_size <- 1000
epsg <- 5070

# Get county boundaries
aoi <- tigris::counties("ID") %>%
  filter(NAME %in% c("Jefferson", "Gem", "Madison", "Clark", "Jerome", "Bonneville", "Teton", "Power", "Blaine", "Elmore", "Butte", "Adams", "Minidoka", "Bingham", "Ada", "Cassia", "Payette", "Fremont", "Bannock", "Twin Falls", "Owyhee", "Washington", "Gooding", "Lincoln", "Camas", "Canyon")) %>%
  st_transform(epsg)
```

Data to retrieve (years: 2002, 2007, 2012, 2017, 2022):

- Income, net cash farm, of operations - net income, measured in $ / operation
- average size of farms
- number/percent of farms by ownership
- number of hired and migrant workers
- cash rent expense
- [wheat (all, winter, spring, spring durum), barley, oats, corn (grain, silage), dry edible beans, dry peas, lentils, sugarbeets, hay (all, alfalfa, other), haylage, potatoes, onions (all), hops, peppermint] harvested
- number cattle (all, beef, milk)
- specialty crops/animals (see https://www.ams.usda.gov/services/grants/scbgp/specialty-crop)

```{r}
#| label: "retrieve data"

# set API key
readRenviron("../.Renviron")
nassqs_auth(key = Sys.getenv('NASSQS_TOKEN'))

# create data frame for clustering
county_ag_data <- expand.grid(county = aoi$NAME,
                              year = seq(2002, 2022, 5))

# list parameters for net income
params <- list(state_alpha = "ID",
               agg_level_desc = "county",
               county_name = unique(county_ag_data$county),
               year__GE = 2002,
               commodity_desc = "income, net cash farm",
               short_desc = "Income, net cash farm, of operations - net income, measured in $ / operation",
               domain_desc = "total")
#retrieve
net_income <- nassqs(params)

# join
county_ag_data <- net_income %>%
  select(county_name, year, Value) %>%
  rename("county" = "county_name",
         "net_income" = "Value") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.integer(year)) %>%
  left_join(county_ag_data, .)

# list parameters for average size of farms
params <- list(state_alpha = "ID",
               agg_level_desc = "county",
               county_name = unique(county_ag_data$county),
               year__GE = 2002,
               commodity_desc = "Farm operations",
               short_desc = "Farm operations - area operated, measured in acres / operation",
               domain_desc = "total")
# retrieve
avg_farm_size <- nassqs(params)

# join
county_ag_data <- avg_farm_size %>%
  select(county_name, year, Value) %>%
  rename("county" = "county_name",
         "avg_farm_acres" = "Value") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.integer(year)) %>%
  left_join(county_ag_data, .)

# farm sizes range

# percent farms by ownership
params <- list(state_alpha = "ID",
               agg_level_desc = "county",
               county_name = unique(county_ag_data$county),
               year__GE = 2002,
               commodity_desc = "Farm operations",
               short_desc = "Farm operations - number of operations",
               domain_desc = "tenure")
# retrieve and clean
farm_own <- nassqs(params)
farm_own_perc <- farm_own %>%
  select(county_name, year, Value, domaincat_desc) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = county_name:year,
              names_from = domaincat_desc,
              values_from = Value) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(total_farms = sum(c_across(`TENURE: (FULL OWNER)`:`TENURE: (TENANT)`))) %>%
  mutate(across(`TENURE: (FULL OWNER)`:`TENURE: (TENANT)`,
                ~.x / total_farms * 100))
# for categories that add to 1, add PCA components to clustering data
farm_own_pca <- prcomp(farm_own_perc[,3:5])

# join
county_ag_data <- farm_own_perc %>%
  cbind(., farm_own_pca$x[,1:2]) %>% # adding components that explain >90% of variance
  rename('ownership_pca1' = 'PC1',
         'ownership_pca2' = 'PC2',
         'county' = 'county_name') %>%
  select(county, year, ownership_pca1, ownership_pca2) %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.integer(year)) %>%
  left_join(county_ag_data, .)

# hired workers (migrant and unpaid worker data starts 2012)
params <- list(state_alpha = "ID",
               agg_level_desc = "county",
               county_name = unique(county_ag_data$county),
               year__GE = 2002,
               commodity_desc = c("Labor", "Farm operations"),
               short_desc = c("Labor, hired - number of workers",
                              "Labor, hired - operations with workers",
                              "Farm operations - number of operations"),
               domain_desc = "total")
# retrieve and clean
farm_workers <- nassqs(params)
farm_workers_perc <- farm_workers %>%
  select(county_name, year, short_desc, Value) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(county_name, year),
              names_from = short_desc,
              values_from = Value) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(perc_farms_w_hired = `LABOR, HIRED - OPERATIONS WITH WORKERS` / `FARM OPERATIONS - NUMBER OF OPERATIONS` * 100,
         avg_hired_per_hiring_farm = `LABOR, HIRED - NUMBER OF WORKERS` / `LABOR, HIRED - OPERATIONS WITH WORKERS`)

# join
county_ag_data <- farm_workers_perc %>%
  select(county_name, year, perc_farms_w_hired, avg_hired_per_hiring_farm) %>%
  rename("county" = "county_name") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.integer(year)) %>%
  left_join(county_ag_data, .)

# cash rent expense
params <- list(state_alpha = "ID",
               agg_level_desc = "county",
               county_name = unique(county_ag_data$county),
               year__GE = 2002,
               commodity_desc = c("Rent", "Farm operations"),
               short_desc = c("Rent, cash, land & buildings - expense, measured in $",
                              "Rent, cash, land & buildings - operations with expense",
                              "Farm operations - number of operations"),
               domain_desc = "total")
# retrieve and clean
farm_rent <- nassqs(params)
farm_rent2 <- farm_rent %>%
  select(county_name, year, short_desc, Value) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(county_name, year),
              names_from = short_desc,
              values_from = Value) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(perc_farms_w_rent = `RENT, CASH, LAND & BUILDINGS - OPERATIONS WITH EXPENSE` / `FARM OPERATIONS - NUMBER OF OPERATIONS` * 100,
         avg_rent_per_renting_farm = `RENT, CASH, LAND & BUILDINGS - EXPENSE, MEASURED IN $` / `RENT, CASH, LAND & BUILDINGS - OPERATIONS WITH EXPENSE`)

# join
county_ag_data <- farm_rent2 %>%
  select(county_name, year, perc_farms_w_rent, avg_rent_per_renting_farm) %>%
  rename("county" = "county_name") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.integer(year)) %>%
  left_join(county_ag_data, .)

# specialty crops/animals
params <- list(state_alpha = "ID",
               agg_level_desc = "county",
               county_name = unique(county_ag_data$county),
               year__GE = 2002,
               short_desc = c("Specialty animal totals, (excl equine) - operations with sales",
                              "Farm operations - number of operations"),
               domain_desc = "total")
# retrieve and clean
specialty_animals <- nassqs(params)
specialty_animals2 <- specialty_animals %>%
  select(county_name, year, short_desc, Value) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(county_name, year),
              names_from = short_desc,
              values_from = Value) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(perc_farms_w_special_animals = `SPECIALTY ANIMAL TOTALS, (EXCL EQUINE) - OPERATIONS WITH SALES` / `FARM OPERATIONS - NUMBER OF OPERATIONS` * 100) %>%
  mutate(perc_farms_w_special_animals = ifelse(is.na(perc_farms_w_special_animals), 0,
                                               perc_farms_w_special_animals))
  
params <- list(state_alpha = "ID",
               agg_level_desc = "county",
               county_name = unique(county_ag_data$county),
               year__GE = 2002,
               short_desc = "Ag land, cropland - acres",
               domain_desc = "total")
total_cropland <- nassqs(params) %>% select(county_name, year, Value)

params <- list(state_alpha = "ID",
               agg_level_desc = "county",
               county_name = unique(county_ag_data$county),
               year = unique(county_ag_data$year),
               commodity_desc = c("almonds", "apples", "apricots", "aronia berries", "blackberries", "blueberries", "cherries", "chestnuts", "currants", "gooseberries", "grapes", "hazelnuts", "nectarines", "peaches", "pears", "pecans", "persimmons", "plums & prunes", "raspberries", "strawberries", "walnuts", # fruits and nuts
                                  # these fruits not on list but fit definition
                                  "boysenberries", "elderberries", "mulberries", "pawpaws", "plum-apricot hybrids",
                                  # vegetables
                                  "artichokes", "asparagus", "beans", "beets", "broccoli", "brussels sprouts", "cabbage", "carrots", "cauliflower", "celery", "cucumbers", "eggplant", "escarole & endive", "greens", "garlic", "horseradish", "lettuce", "melons", "okra", "peas", "onions", "parsley", "parsnips", "peppers", "potatoes", "pumpkins", "radishes", "rhubarb", "spinach", "squash", "sweet corn", "sweet potatoes", "tomatoes", "turnips",
                                  "chickpeas", "lentils",
                                  # herbs
                                  "hops", "mint", "chicory", "ginger root", "watercress"),
               domain_desc = "total",
               util_practice_desc = c("all utilization practices", "oil"),
               prodn_practice_desc = "all production practices")
specialty_crops <- nassqs_acres(params, area = c("AREA BEARING", "AREA NON-BEARING", "AREA HARVESTED", "AREA IN PRODUCTION")) %>%
  # special filters to narrow down imprecise queries
  filter(!(commodity_desc == "BEANS" &
             !(class_desc == "DRY EDIBLE, LIMA" |
                 class_desc == "SNAP" |
                 class_desc == "GREEN, LIMA")) &
           !(commodity_desc == "LETTUCE" & !(class_desc == "ALL CLASSES")) &
           !(commodity_desc == "PEARS" & !(class_desc == "ALL CLASSES")) &
           !(commodity_desc == "PEACHES" & !(class_desc == "ALL CLASSES")) &
           !(commodity_desc == "RASPBERRIES" & !(class_desc == "ALL CLASSES")) &
           !(commodity_desc == "SQUASH" & !(class_desc == "ALL CLASSES")) &
           !(commodity_desc == "MINT" & !(class_desc == "ALL CLASSES")))
# need to add horticulture separately
horticulture <- nassqs(state_alpha = "ID",
               agg_level_desc = "county",
               county_name = unique(county_ag_data$county),
               year = unique(county_ag_data$year),
               commodity_desc = c("cut christmas trees", "horticulture totals"),
               unit_desc = "acres",
               prodn_practice_desc = c("all production practices", "in the open"),
               domain_desc = "total")

# combine all specialy crops and calculate percent area
specialty_crops_total <- rbind(specialty_crops, horticulture) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
  group_by(county_name, year) %>%
  summarise(acres_specialty_crops = sum(Value)) %>%
  right_join(., total_cropland) %>%
  rename("tot_cropland" = "Value") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(acres_specialty_crops = ifelse(is.na(acres_specialty_crops), 0, acres_specialty_crops),
         perc_specialty_cropland = acres_specialty_crops/tot_cropland * 100)

# join
county_ag_data <- left_join(specialty_crops_total, specialty_animals2) %>%
  select(county_name, year, perc_specialty_cropland, perc_farms_w_special_animals) %>%
  rename("county" = "county_name") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.integer(year)) %>%
  left_join(county_ag_data, .)
```

In exploratory plots, we look for evidence of grouping (e.g. bimodal distributions in histograms, clumping in scatterplots).

```{r}
hist(county_ag_data$net_income, breaks = 20)
hist(county_ag_data$avg_farm_acres, breaks = 20)
hist(county_ag_data$ownership_pca1, breaks = 20)
hist(county_ag_data$ownership_pca2, breaks = 20)
hist(county_ag_data$perc_farms_w_hired, breaks = 20)
hist(county_ag_data$avg_hired_per_hiring_farm, breaks = 20)
hist(county_ag_data$perc_farms_w_rent, breaks = 20)
hist(county_ag_data$avg_rent_per_renting_farm, breaks = 20)
hist(county_ag_data$perc_specialty_cropland, breaks = 20)
hist(county_ag_data$perc_farms_w_special_animals, breaks = 20)

# overall clumping may be seen in PCA
ag_pca <- prcomp(scale(county_ag_data[,-c(1:2)]))
summary(ag_pca)
biplot(ag_pca)
```

Clustering:

```{r}
# test clusters
NbClust::NbClust(ag_pca$x[,1:7], method="kmeans", index="all")
test <- kmeans(ag_pca$x[,1:7], 2)
factoextra::fviz_pca_biplot(ag_pca, habillage=as.factor(test$cluster))

county_year_ag_clust <- left_join(county_ag_data, aoi[,c("NAME", "geometry")], by = c("county" = "NAME")) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  cbind(., test$cluster)

ggplot(county_year_ag_clust, aes(fill = factor(test.cluster))) +
  geom_sf() +
  facet_wrap(vars(year))

# cluster meanings
ag_clusts <- county_year_ag_clust %>%
  mutate(across(net_income:perc_farms_w_special_animals,
                ~scale(.x))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = net_income:perc_farms_w_special_animals,
               names_to = "input_data_name",
               values_to = "input_data_value")
whisker_lengths <- ag_clusts %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(test.cluster, input_data_name) %>%
  summarise(upper_whisker = min(max(input_data_value), quantile(input_data_value, 0.75) + 1.5 * IQR(input_data_value)),
            lower_whisker = max(min(input_data_value), quantile(input_data_value, 0.25) - 1.5 * IQR(input_data_value))) %>%
  mutate(touches_zero = ifelse(upper_whisker>0 & lower_whisker>0, FALSE,
                               ifelse(upper_whisker<0 & lower_whisker<0, FALSE, TRUE))) %>%
  select(-c(upper_whisker, lower_whisker))

left_join(ag_clusts, whisker_lengths) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = input_data_value, y = input_data_name,
                   fill = touches_zero),
               outliers = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(facets = "test.cluster")
```

Barcode analysis:

```{r}
barcodes <- county_year_ag_clust %>%
  select(county, year, test.cluster) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(county, geometry),
              names_from = year,
              values_from = test.cluster) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(barcode = paste(c_across(`2002`:`2022`), collapse = ""))

table(barcodes$barcode)

ggplot(barcodes, aes(fill=barcode)) +
  geom_sf()
```
